messages:
Emma S: Observed an immediate spike in KMS error rates at 09:03 UTC, followed by failing model loads. Correlating with automated key rotation job.
Raj P: Yep seeing the same — inference nodes getting 403 from KMS when fetching DEK. Error sample: `AccessDeniedException: MissingPermission: kms:GetKeyMaterial`.
Oncall Bot: Incident created (INC-2026-113) — severity: high. Pager duty notified.
Marta Sec: Call out: was rotation scheduled? Who kicked it off?
Kai I: I ran a manual rotation earlier during the maintenance window to rotate key `projects/rw/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/enc-v3` — I thought the new policy was in place.
Dave O: That key rotation triggered a GAP: service account used by runtime wasn't included in new key IAM binding -> immediate denies.
Emma S: Action: roll back to previous key version to restore reads. Can infra revert and re-add binding atomically?
Kai I: Starting rollback now. Command I'm running:
```
# set primary to previous version
gcloud kms keys versions update 3 --primary --key=enc-v3 --keyring=inference --location=global
```
Kai I: Rolling back should be quick; pushing status.
Raj P: Prep note: if we flip the primary, some nodes cache DEKs; we'll need to restart the sidecar on nodes that failed to re-request the new DEK. I'll queue a rolling restart after rollback.
Marta Sec: Check audit logs for any anomalous accesses during the window. Use `logName=\"projects/rw/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Faccess_log\"` and filter for key name.
Dave O: I see successful rebind just applied for service account `svc-runtime@rw.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — but after rollback, need to confirm decrypts succeed.
Oncall Bot: Update: rollback command completed at 09:12 UTC. (INC-2026-113).
Emma S: Confirming: one node still failing to decrypt, restart sidecar on node-47.
Raj P: Restart done. node-47 now healthy. Traces show model-init latencies back to normal.
Marta Sec: Audit summary to collect: rotation initiator (Kai), IAM diff, timestamps, list of affected instances, and any failed decrypt attempts hash. I'll start a quick doc.
Alisha P: Heads up to product — some requests saw 5xx between 09:03-09:14 UTC, potential customer impact. I'll draft a short status note for customers.
Emma S: Good. Postmortem tasks: 1) add pre-rotation IAM checklist + automated verification, 2) prevent manual rotations without infra+sec signoff, 3) add alert for KMS Denies with playbook link. Assign owners?
Marta Sec: I'll take 1 and 3 with Raj.
Kai I: I'll take 2 and create a constrained automation flow with required tags so rotations can't be manual without a flag.
Dave O: Handoff to next oncall: document in incident thread, link to logs, and list of commands performed.
Emma S: Thanks all. Next oncall (Kai until 18:00 UTC) — Kai, please pick up the post-incident doc and coordinate with Sec to verify no lingering access gaps. I'll update pager notes.
Oncall Bot: Handoff scheduled: next shift user=Kai I, start=09:30 UTC, incident=INC-2026-113.
Emma S: End of thread for now. Keep channel updated if anything new.
